integrity: The 1995 source date, DOI, pages, and abstract-level scope were verified. A complete 2012 Koper treatment was inspected for the standard and symmetric equations, critical manifold, fold geometry, and classical parameter values, including targeted searches for conditional and variance formulations. The 2015 homoclinic work and a later full three-timescale treatment were compared at statement and implication level. The regression laws, derivative-energy balance, equality cases, and fold-strip consequence were independently reconstructed and replayed with the packaged checker.
scientific_limitations: The fold-strip conclusion assumes \(k<0\), the parameter sign used in the classical mixed-mode regime.
The strip condition is necessary for non-equilibrium compact stationary recurrence, not sufficient for an MMO or homoclinic orbit.
The theorem does not determine MMO signatures, periods, canard counts, or bifurcation thresholds.
The complete 1995 primary article was not available through the inspected open route.
A short equivalent invariant-measure balance could remain in unindexed slow–fast literature.
title: Exact speed-weighted fold balance in the Koper mixed-mode oscillator
